companies.name: Botree Recycling Technologies
companies.description: Suzhou-based battery materials recycling company; end-to-end solutions recovering critical battery materials (nickel, cobalt, lithium, LFP direct regeneration), equipment and turnkey recycling projects

investors.investorName: Taiping Science and Technology Innovation Fund

companies.name: peakAmp
companies.description: Battery circularity startup building India's first full-stack, tech-enabled solution for collection, segregation and recycling of lithium-ion batteries, with second-life repurposing and high-purity material recovery
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.71). Shared terms: battery, recycling, recovery, material, lithium, ion, batterie. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: BatX Energies
companies.description: Battery recycling startup extracting 99.95% pure lithium, nickel, and cobalt from black mass of Li-ion cells using proprietary zero-waste hydro-electro process
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.71). Shared terms: battery, recycling, lithium, ion. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: Renewable Metals
companies.description: Renewable Metals has developed an alkali-based hydrometallurgical process that recovers lithium, cobalt, nickel, copper, and manganese from end-of-life lithium-ion batteries, achieving over 95% recovery without producing sodium sulphate waste. It builds modular recycling plants and targets battery recyclers and critical-minerals buyers in Western markets, starting with a commercial prototype plant in Kewdale, Western Australia.
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.63). Shared terms: battery, recycling, recovery, critical, lithium, ion, batterie. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: NEU Battery Materials
companies.description: Singapore-based material security company that recycles lithium iron phosphate (LFP) batteries using a patented electrochemical redox targeting process to recover battery-grade lithium from cathode production scrap and end-of-life black mass. It sells recovered lithium and recycling capacity to battery manufacturers, eMobility and energy storage firms, and e-waste recyclers.
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.58). Shared terms: battery, recycling, material, lithium, batterie. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: Redwood Materials
companies.description: Redwood Materials recovers critical materials including lithium, cobalt, nickel and copper by recycling lithium-ion batteries, and also produces cathode active material and grid-scale energy storage systems. Its customers span the automotive, battery manufacturing and technology industries, including Volkswagen, Panasonic, Toyota and Lyft.
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.56). Shared terms: battery, recycling, critical, material, lithium, ion, batterie. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: R3 Robotics
companies.description: R3 Robotics (formerly Circu Li-ion) builds AI-powered robotic systems that automate the industrial-scale disassembly of lithium-ion EV battery packs and complete electric vehicle systems (e-drives, power electronics). It sells disassembly-as-a-service and robotics-as-a-service to battery recyclers and automotive OEMs to recover critical raw materials and reusable components.
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.42). Shared terms: battery, critical, material, lithium, ion. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: Altilium
companies.description: Altilium is a UK clean technology company that recovers critical battery materials from end-of-life EV batteries and manufacturing scrap using its proprietary EcoCathode and EcoAnode processes, producing battery precursors, cathode active materials (CAM), pCAM and anode active material (AAM) for reuse in new batteries. Its buyers are UK automotive, battery manufacturers and gigafactories seeking domestically sourced, low-carbon battery materials.
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.42). Shared terms: battery, critical, material, batterie. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: DREV
companies.description: DREV develops the patented Vault contamination-control system that captures and recovers microscopic metal 'black dust' generated in battery gigafactories, recycling and refining plants, recovering critical metals such as nickel, cobalt, lithium and copper. Its customers are battery manufacturers and recyclers seeking safer, more efficient and circular production.
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.41). Shared terms: battery, recycling, critical, lithium. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: Mecaware
companies.description: Mecaware is a French cleantech company that recycles gigafactory battery-production scrap and end-of-life lithium-ion batteries to recover critical battery metals (lithium, nickel, cobalt, manganese, copper). It sells recycled battery-grade metals to European battery and gigafactory manufacturers.
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.36). Shared terms: battery, critical, lithium, ion, batterie. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.
